summary: No installer-harm behavior observed in zagents-message-bus 1.0.5
details: The package zagents-message-bus 1.0.5 was examined and no evidence of installer-side harm was found. No install-time or import-time network activity, no credential or environment scraping, no filesystem persistence outside the package's own directory, no fetch-and-execute of remote code, and no silent relay of caller-supplied data to a hardcoded destination were observed.
